_README: MANUAL POPULATION REQUIRED. This file is a curated lookup of real-world player-of-the-season winners, used to annotate the per-(league, season) MVP grid in project 03's analysis page. The build pipeline does NOT write to this file — keep it source-controlled and edit it by hand. Set `name: null` for cells where no award was given or the winner is unknown. `source` is a short label like 'Ballon d'Or' or 'PFA POTY' or 'Kicker' — used as a tooltip / footnote on the chart.
